name: secure-e2e-chat
description: A lightweight browser-based end-to-end encrypted chat site.

scripts.build: terser public/app.js --compress --mangle --output public/app.min.js && cleancss -o public/styles.min.css public/styles.css && node scripts/write-build-manifest.js
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check tests/e2e.test.js && npm run verify:build
